name: Electric instead of gas-pneumatic controllers
applications: methane reduction at wellsites and compressor stations
principle: Gas-driven pneumatic controllers vent methane to operate valves; replacing them with instrument air or electric controllers removes that venting. EPA Natural Gas STAR reports gas pneumatic devices vented about 51 Bcf/yr in production (2006) and a conversion typically costs $45,000 to $75,000 with payback in months at $7/Mcf.

process_steps.name: Install instrument air or electric controllers

key_equipment: solar and battery power at remote sites

performance.metric: gas vented by pneumatic controllers in US production
